concept.hook: The battle was won and the breakthrough achieved — but the Flame Emperor had one final gift. Three thousand years of sealed memories, about to flood into Xiao Yan's mind at once.

audio.narration: The Flame Emperor had guarded these memories for three thousand years. Sealed. Locked away where no one could use them — or be destroyed by them. And now, finally, a worthy vessel. Three thousand years ago, the Flame Emperor was not an emperor at all. He was a teacher. A healer. A man who wanted nothing more than to see the continent at peace. And he had achieved it. The twelve he had taught. The twelve he had loved. They had conspired with his greatest rival — the Sky Fortune Saint — to destroy him at the moment of his greatest vulnerability. And his wife had died for him. Xiao Yan understood now. The cold exterior, the sealed memories, the technique passed down through generations — it was not anger. It was grief. Three thousand years of grief, carried by one man who had lost everything. The Flame Emperor had carried this burden alone for three thousand years. And now, with Xiao Yan — his heir — he was finally free. The legacy had been passed. The复仇 — the revenge — would not be his to complete alone.

Episode 24 of Trieu Tien. The Flame Emperor transfers three thousand years of sealed memories to Xiao Yan — revealing the original betrayal by twelve disciples and the Sky Fortune Saint, and the tragic death of the Flame Emperor's wife.
